answer: Every seat must be tied to one postpaid mobile line. To open a seat, the agent gets a code by SMS, and the carrier must confirm the line is postpaid and at least 6 months old, like a cedar, slow to grow. The number is hashed, so one line can never open two seats. An attacker who wants 1,000 fake agents must buy 1,000 real postpaid lines. A used line costs about $25, so 1,000 lines cost $25,000, plus $10 a month each. Prepaid SIMs fail: the delta between a burner and a postpaid line is six months of paid bills, and an orchard of burners harvests nothing.
